component.text: Final quality combines CRISPR sequence accuracy with correction of the strain profile. The machine keeps both parts hidden during synthesis so the player must verify the batch experimentally.

Exact-strain reports, gene evidence and a suitable Cas/PAM module raise confidence. Missing or mismatched evidence limits the attainable result. Synthesis still works with incomplete assay support, but the batch is less reliable.

Use a produced vaccine on a blood-filled tube carrying the candidate infection, then calibrate and scan the vaccinated blood in a Microscope. The result reports only combined quality. Better quality also extends exact-strain immunity duration.
